description: Use this when the user asks about one European Parliament dossier (procedure): what it is, its type, lead committee, rapporteurs, the steps so far in Parliament, its plenary votes, and the Legislative Observatory summary. Takes a procedure reference such as "2023/0212(COD)" or an id such as "2023-0212" (use search_parliament first if you only know the title).

votes_page.description: Page of plenary votes, 50 per page.
